target_customer: Startups and small and mid-size businesses in Finland, Europe and the US that need bookkeeping, payroll and tax filings
problem: Traditional accounting firms are slow and costly for routine bookkeeping and filings; founders want books kept current and queryable without admin work.
business_model: Accounting services firm with AI agents doing the work and certified accountants signing off; fixed monthly fee

founders.name: Sami Laakkonen
prior_employers: clients including Google and Bloomberg (data infrastructure work)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he competed twice in the Nordplus International Science Olympiad in physics and was a fighter pilot trainee.

competitors.name: Basis
competitors.what: AI agents for accounting firms (sells to firms, not direct to startups)
competitors.funding_then: $100M Series B at $1.15B valuation reported Feb 2026

competitors.name: Pilot
competitors.what: Bookkeeping service that introduced an AI Accountant in Feb 2026, from $99 per month

competitors.name: Accrual
competitors.what: AI-native automation for accounting firm preparation and review workflows

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting to banks, payroll and ledgers and having agents produce accurate books and filings is standard integration work with hard parts in accuracy, multi-country tax rules and review workflow.

defensibility.rationale: Accounting data and licensed signoff create some switching costs, but well-funded rivals are building the same AI-native service.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors were already shipping AI accounting by the batch start; no acquisition event found for Bear.

market_need_then: AI-native accounting drew large funding in 2026 (Basis, Accrual), showing demand for automating bookkeeping. The company's Finnish site claims more than 20 client companies (company claim).

branding.domain_note: Uses bear.inc; the former name's domain was lastaccountingcompany.com.

identity.mascot_or_character: Glowing orange bear in the website hero image
identity.visual_style: Orange bear against a blurred green garden
identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly and direct; Finnish tagline meaning bookkeeping at the speed of thought; write to Bear like a colleague

rebrands.why: Not stated; YC page notes the former name and domain

brand_strength.rationale: A short friendly name and a mascot image are assets, but no press or community evidence was found and many other companies use the name Bear.

outcome_analysis: Bear is a Summer 2026 company with no outcome yet. It renamed from the longer Last Accounting Company, has technical Finnish founders with financial data infrastructure experience, and sells a service rather than software, but faces heavily funded AI accounting competitors.
notes: No funding found for this company; searches returned a different company named Bear AI (generative engine optimization) with $500K, which is not this one. The YC launch post names four founders (adding Veikko and Pietari) while the profile lists two with team size 3; only the two profiled founders are recorded. HQ Helsinki per YC page. Outcome search found no acquisition or shutdown.
